reviewer: Pickle: official-source winter shower water, residual chlorine, rust and shower filter comparison guide
method: Reviewed the draft against 21 sources on 2026-11-11. Residual chlorine limits: 수도법 시행규칙 제22조의4③ sets tap residual chlorine at 0.1–4.0 mg/L; 고산군청 수도사업소 water-quality table (환경부 기준 재게시) gives free residual chlorine ≤4.0 mg/L, total THM ≤0.1 mg/L, chloroform ≤0.08 mg/L, with 먹는물 수질기준 및 검사 등에 관한 규칙 별표 1 as the legal basis. Shower exposure: Silva et al. 2013 (J Expo Sci Environ Epidemiol, jes201280) 100 volunteers, 10-min shower, shower-water total THM GM 96.2 μg/L, shower air 5.8→351 μg/m3, blood total THM 16.5→299 ng/L; Cantor et al. 2008 (Epidemiology) blood chloroform 11→187 ng/L; Nuckols et al. 2005 (EHP, doi 10.1289/ehp.7141) inhalation/dermal routes raise blood THM more than ingestion and hot-water activities doubled levels. Skin: Seki et al. 2003 (J Dermatol, doi 10.1111/j.1346-8138.2003.tb00371.x) 20 AD and 10 control subjects, 40 °C for 10 min, stratum corneum water-holding capacity fell from 0.5 mg/L in AD and SC hydration differed at 1.0 and 2.0 mg/L, controls only at 2.0 mg/L; Perkin et al. 2016 (JACI, doi 10.1016/j.jaci.2016.03.031) 1,303 infants found hardness associated but chlorine effect uncertain. Water temperature: Herrero-Fernandez et al. 2022 (J Clin Med, doi 10.3390/jcm11020298) 50 volunteers, 41.29 °C 10-min immersion, TEWL 25.75→58.58 g/h/m2, pH 6.33→6.65, erythema 249.45→286.34 AU, cold 11.13 °C TEWL 34.96. Acne: KDCA 국가건강정보포털 여드름 (2026-08-03) — 1 °C body temperature raises sebum 10%, sebaceous distribution on face/chest/back, winter thickening of stratum corneum blocks pores, poor hygiene is not a cause, 85% of ages 12–25 affected; KDCA 습진 (2026-05-18) dry eczema from frequent bathing, harsh scrubbing and no moisturiser; KDCA 아토피피부염 예방관리수칙 — lukewarm 10-min bath, moisturiser twice daily, 22–24 °C and 40–50% humidity. Filters: KCA press release 2021-11-30 (no=1003228055) — 20 shower filters, 7 (35.0%) below 80% residual-chlorine removal, 6 without test reports, 1 with a 100% report still failing, one product removing under 10%; KBS 2021-11-30 for the 10% detail; 컨슈머치 2024-03-22 on the 청주녹색소비자연대 test of 9 products (Dr.Piel 2-layer, Daelim Bath Declin, Pure Rain non-detect after 100 L) and its advice to separate physical adsorption filters from chemical vitamin filters. Vitamin C chemistry: Zhang 2013 (IJERA) 1:1 molar ratio, 10 mg/L ascorbic acid for 4 mg/L chlorine, complete within 1 min; USDA FS 05231301 about 2.5 parts ascorbic acid per 1 part chlorine and 1 g per 100 gallons at 1 mg/L. Rust particles: Barkatt et al. 2009 (Water Research) almost all tap-water corrosion solids removed by 5-micron filters, with Pb/Cu/As adsorbed; 조재익 등 2013 (한국마린엔지니어링학회지) measured 30–47 μm pores in domestic sediment filters. Coupang checks on 2026-11-11: 닥터피엘 샤워기 기본세트 37,900 won (list 50,000), 2,489 reviews, item 6360359973-22466224083; 퓨어썸 필터 샤워기 19,900 won (list 40,000), 25,541 reviews, Rocket delivery, manufacturer 성일화학, refill 3p 11,900 won with 24,214 reviews, item 8252045206-23758992694; SHIFT 아로마 캡슐 샤워기 + 필터 4p 47,800 won (list 65,500), 58 reviews, item 8959101148-26214824851, capsules sold separately. Affiliate deep links were issued from those live product URLs and each returned HTTP 302 to the matching itemId on 2026-11-11 08:10 KST. The filter upkeep figure (3,967 won per filter, 23,800–47,600 won per year) is arithmetic on the 11,900 won 3-pack at a 1–2 month change interval. Kakao Gift curator links are reused live links (lHJeWpFr 부이 바디 에어 드라이어, uCv9qswk 비건 립 버터 듀오) because the curator dashboard still stops at a DKAPTCHA map challenge; both returned HTTP 200 with matching og:title on 2026-11-11. Verified the draft contains no 진단/치료법/처방/복용법/부작용 wording in title, description, targetQuery, secondaryQueries or tags, and that every product claim matches the seller page (including that the SHIFT capsule is not included in the set and that the linked PureSum listing displays no residual-chlorine test report).
